start.welcome:
📚 ArchiveBOT

Welcome to the Internet Document Archiver.

Send any article or webpage URL to start.

Supported:
• WeChat Official Accounts
• X / Twitter
• Xiaohongshu
• Weibo
• Zhihu
• Reddit
• YouTube
• Generic Web Pages
• More platforms

After sending a URL, choose:

📄 PDF
📝 Markdown
🖼 Images
📦 All

Completed files will be sent to you automatically.
